methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Virginia advanced manufacturing hub receives $24.8M federal grant
signals.signal_reading: A $24.8M federal investment in advanced manufacturing infrastructure could enable distributed AI capability development across Virginia's manufacturing regions if knowledge networks form beyond initial hub concentration points.

signals.title: Virginia's AI challenge isn't data centers. It's small-business adoption | Guest column - Richmond Times-Dispatch
signals.signal_reading: Explicit acknowledgment that Virginia's AI challenge centers on small-business adoption gaps signals the current reality of shallow, uneven distribution despite infrastructure investments—the core diagnostic of scenario four.

signals.title: Virginia Tech tests thermal cameras and AI to warn drivers of animals near roads - WDBJ7
signals.signal_reading: Virginia Tech's applied AI research for wildlife detection demonstrates deep technical capability in the New River Valley, but remains institutionally contained rather than diffusing into regional business ecosystems.

signals.title: Mace AI funds AI safety research at University of Virginia’s School of Data Science (UVA) - TheStreet
signals.signal_reading: External AI safety funding flowing to UVA's School of Data Science reinforces metro concentration of advanced AI capability within academic institutions, creating excellence silos without clear pathways to distributed implementation.

signals.title: CAREER CORNER: Greater Roanoke workforce board joins five-board Appalachian Advancement initiative - WDBJ7
signals.signal_reading: Five workforce boards forming an Appalachian Advancement initiative signals potential for peer-network-driven capability building in historically underserved regions, the essential infrastructure for distributed AI fluency beyond metro centers.
